messages:
olivia_sales: Quick escalation  AtlasBank procurement sent back the SIG and is insisting on HSM-backed customer keys + hardware attestation for any inference cache used during the trial. They say they won't sign without either HSM attestation or an explicit vendor exception. Need guidance and a one-paragraph response we can send them.

mike_sec: Thanks Olivia. Can you paste the exact CAIQ line?

olivia_sales: Heres the line: 'Does the vendor support customer-managed, hardware-backed (HSM) keys with attestation for transient caches and any token-like persisted artifacts? If unavailable, provide compensating controls and a vendor-signed risk acceptance.'

rana_prod: Product note: Hosted inference does not expose customer HSM for ephemeral in-memory caches or in-flight replicas. Dedicated/Private can be configured to use customer KMS/HSM for persisted data. We should prepare: (1) customer-facing paragraph, (2) internal risk acceptance memo with compensating controls, (3) timeline for manual attestation package.

carl_infra: Draft internal compensating controls (concise):
```
- Ephemeral-only caching: no disk writes; GC on session end.
- Default short TTL: 30s, configurable to 10s for POC.
- In-process memory encryption and frequent key rotation at provider side.
- CMEK for persisted blobs (logs, traces, checkpoints) with option for customer-supplied key.
- mTLS and least-privilege service roles; strict network ACLs between tenants.
- Immutable, write-once audit trail for key access events stored in customer region (12mo).
- Manual signed integrity report (runtime snapshot + access logs) available on request (3 business days).
```

mike_sec: Add continuous anomaly detection on key usage and an incident escalation playbook. Residual risk: "elevated" for regulated banking; "moderate" otherwise. I'll prepare the internal risk acceptance template and route to CISO for approval.

sylvia_legal: External wording needs to be customer-friendly and non-technical. Suggested paragraph: "Hosted Redwood inference uses transient, in-memory caches with strict isolation and short time-to-live to reduce exposure. Hardware-backed attestation for ephemeral memory is supported via Dedicated/private deployments; for hosted deployments, Redwood provides customer-managed encryption for persisted artifacts, enhanced audit logging, and can provide a vendor-signed risk acceptance for POC deployments. Contact your account team for Dedicated/private options."

olivia_sales: AtlasBank needs a reply by EOD tomorrow for procurement. Can we get the signed memo fast?

carl_infra: Manual attestation package ETA = 3 business days for first delivery, 1 day for follow-ups. Automation of attestation reports ~6-9 weeks. We can set TTL to 10s immediately for the POC.

mike_sec: Creating internal ticket SEC-2233 for AtlasBank exception. Reviewers: mike_sec, sylvia_legal, ciso. Will request CISO sign-off today.

sec-bot: SEC-2233 created and linked to AtlasBank procurement thread: https://redwood.internal/tickets/SEC-2233 (assignees: mike_sec, sylvia_legal, ciso).

olivia_sales: Perfect  please drop the finalized one-paragraph and the internal memo link here once SEC-2233 has the doc. Tagging @rana_prod @carl_infra @mike_sec. Thanks! :pray:
